data.description: Enable Rebar MCP on the AWS server running Gerrit and code review. Configure the MCP server to use the same auto update used by code review. Ensure that the auto update drain is safe for MCP operations. Store the necessary credentials to access this server in a local-only config file in the repo root for rebar. Update the configuration for copilot, codex, and claude to connect to the rebar MCP server. Verify that the MCP is successfully configured for all 3 using basic CLI commands. Update the rebar local guidance to require using the MCP server for all rebar operations unless performing operations that require local code (e.g. testing, investigation, debugging, validation). Update guidance to document that all certified plan review, code review, and completion verifier operations must be certified through the MCP server.
data.title: Enable MCP on AWS
